parameters.jsCode:
const vendor = $input.item.json; const aiComment = $('AI Vendor Comment').item.json; const monthLabel = $('Score All Vendors').item.json.monthLabel; const gradeColor = vendor.gradeColor || '#F59E0B'; const grade = vendor.grade || 'C'; const totalScore = vendor.totalScore || 0; // Progress bar widths const volWidth = Math.round((vendor.volumeScore / 40) * 100); const qualWidth = Math.round((vendor.qualityScore / 30) * 100); const timeWidth = Math.round((vendor.timelinessScore / 30) * 100); const html = `
♻ TraceFlow
Vendor Scorecard — ${monthLabel}
${vendor.name}
${vendor.material || 'Material'} Supplier
${grade}
${totalScore}/100
Overall Score
Score Breakdown
Volume (40 pts) ${vendor.volumeScore}/40
Quality / Low Loss (30 pts) ${vendor.qualityScore}/30
Timeliness (30 pts) ${vendor.timelinessScore}/30
Volume Supplied
${(vendor.total_kg||0).toLocaleString()}
kilograms
Loss Rate
${vendor.loss_rate||0}%
material loss
Avg Delivery
${vendor.avg_delivery_days||'N/A'}
days
✦ Performance Review
${aiComment.reply || 'Performance review not available.'}
TraceFlow Vendor Scorecard · ${monthLabel} · Auto-generated
`; return [{ json: { html, vendorName: vendor.name, vendorEmail: vendor.email || null, subject: `Your TraceFlow Vendor Scorecard — ${monthLabel} | Grade: ${grade} (${totalScore}/100)`, grade, totalScore } }];
